candidates.explanation: Pipeline-aware conservative relaxation: reduce orders when pipeline is high relative to recent demand, but never cut so much that downstream backlog risk increases. Small coordinated corrections across nodes.
Backlog-sensitive smoothing: increase orders when backlog is high and pipeline is low, but avoid over-ordering when pipeline already covers demand. Downstream service protected by limiting cuts.

Growth-adaptive damping: when recent demand exceeds baseline, slightly increase orders to avoid stockouts; when pipeline is excessive relative to growth, reduce cautiously. Keeps corrections small and coordinated.

rules.when: growth > 1.2 and pipeline < recent and backlog > 0
